# discord_server_incident_actions (Resource)

Manages a server's incident actions, which pause invites or direct messages between members for up to 24 hours during a raid. Actions end on their own when their time passes; that is not treated as drift. An action lifted early outside Terraform is set again on the next apply. Destroying the resource lifts both actions. To pause invites indefinitely, use `invites_disabled` on `discord_server_settings`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pause invites for 12 hours from the first apply. A fixed timestamp keeps
# the plan stable, unlike timestamp(), which changes on every run. Replace
# the time_offset to start a new pause.
resource "time_offset" "raid" {
  offset_hours = 12
}

resource "discord_server_incident_actions" "main" {
  server_id              = var.server_id
  invites_disabled_until = time_offset.raid.rfc3339
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `dms_disabled_until` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp until which direct messages are paused, at most 24 hours after the apply, e.g. `time_offset.raid.rfc3339` from the `hashicorp/time` provider. Omit or set to null to lift the action. Once the time passes the action ends on its own and the plan stays empty; set a new timestamp to start it again.
- `invites_disabled_until` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp until which invites are paused, at most 24 hours after the apply, e.g. `time_offset.raid.rfc3339` from the `hashicorp/time` provider. Omit or set to null to lift the action. Once the time passes the action ends on its own and the plan stays empty; set a new timestamp to start it again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_server_incident_actions.main
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_server_incident_actions.main <server_id>
```
